output.answer_markdown: The passages do not support a full answer. Quanta's FY2023 10-K passage [3] contains no seasonality discussion and no comparison of Canadian and U.S. operations. The seasonality passages ([2], [7]) come from a different company's filings (accession 0000950170, a manufacturer with outsourced manufacturing and cloud revenue) and do not name Quanta, so they cannot be attributed to Quanta. Regarding Canada, the FY2023 passage only says the largest component of unapproved change orders and claims ($778.9 million) relates to a large renewable transmission project in Canada [3]. Passage [6] (FY2020 10-K) says 79% of Quanta's foreign revenues in 2020 were earned in Canada, but it gives no U.S. comparison.
